q1.text: Is the room colder now than when you sat down?

q2.text: Did the clock on the wall stop ticking a moment ago?

q3.text: Did you come into this room alone tonight?

q4.text: Is the candle flame leaning toward the empty chair?

q5.text: May I write my name in the dust on the table?

q6.text: Can you hear a second breath in the room, slow and quiet?

q7.text: Will you leave the small lamp in the window burning for me?

q8.text: Shall I open the door that was locked when you came in?

lamp.title: The lamp stays lit
lamp.text: The cold drains out of the room. The spirit is at peace, and the little lamp in the window burns on, warm and steady.

door.title: The door is open
door.text: A door you had never noticed swings open without a sound. Beyond it is a soft grey light, and nobody can say where it leads.

chair.title: The empty chair
chair.text: The candle stands straight again. The chair across the table stays empty, and the room goes quiet.
